messages:
sara-support: forwarding an urgent escalation from Contoso — they lost access to billing and model deploys after last night's RBAC refactor. customer reports console shows permission denied and model deploys fail with KMS errors. attaching their error copy below.

contoso-admin: "When I try to open Billing > Invoices I get: '403 Forbidden — missing permission: billing.invoices.view'.
Attempting to deploy model -> failed: 'kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-1234'
We have a scheduled demo at 10am PST, blocked."

omar-security: thanks — was the roles-v2 rollout applied cluster-wide last night? tag me the tenant id and I'll pull the audit trail. also need the service account ARN that attempted the decrypt.

sara-support: tenant=contoso-prod, svc acct = arn:aws:iam::222222:role/contoso-redwood-svc, got the user's screenshots. 

lee-eng-sre: quick sanity check — the RBAC refactor touched role->attribute mapping which can stop KMS grants from being referenced if subject format changed (svcacct vs service:...). can you paste the exact KMS error log (redacted) and the `redwoodctl` call they used to deploy?

contoso-admin: pasted logs (redacted):
```
2026-04-01T02:12:03Z ERROR model-deploy controller failed to decrypt model key: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::222222:role/contoso-redwood-svc is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-1234
CausedBy: principal-format mismatch: expected principal service:contoso-redwood-svc but got iam:role/contoso-redwood-svc
```

jess-ps: this screams principal-format/rolesync mismatch. the roles-v2 job swapped subject formats to `service:<name>` for cross-tenant grants. if external KMS grants still reference the old `iam:role/...` principal they will fail.

audit-bot: event:rolesync-batch 2026-04-01T00:45:12Z -> migrated 112 tenant role mappings (job-id=rolesync-20260401-00). changed subject namespace from `iam:role` to `service` for tenants: contoso-prod, alpha-int, beta-qa.

omar-security: confirmed by audit-bot. that explains it. we need a two-step fix: (1) temporary add a compatibility grant for contoso-prod that allows `iam:role/contoso-redwood-svc` to decrypt the key, (2) schedule a one-time KMS grant migration to canonical `service:<name>` and notify customers.

lee-eng-sre: propose immediate workaround: run a scoped `aws kms create-grant` for the key with grantee-principal set to the old iam role. example CLI we can run from ops jumpbox: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-1234 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::222222:role/contoso-redwood-svc --operations Decrypt --name temporary-rolesync-compat
```

sara-support: can take that action now if you confirm perms. contoso is OK with temporary grant, they want the demo to proceed.

omar-security: i'll approve the temporary grant, but we must rotate it out after migration. @jess-ps can you draft the migration runbook and a customer-facing note? add rollback steps and how to validate via `kms:ListGrants` and redwoodctl token test.

jess-ps: on it. rough checklist: 1) list all keys referenced by tenants with legacy principal format, 2) create compatibility grants, 3) update KMS grant generators to use `service:<name>`, 4) run verification deploys, 5) delete compatibility grants after 72h with notification. will post PR and customer notice by EOD.

lee-eng-sre: temporary grant applied -> ran `aws kms list-grants --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-1234` shows grant 'temporary-rolesync-compat' active. contoso reports model deploys and billing UI working.

contoso-admin: confirmed :white_check_mark: demo completed successfully. thanks for the fast help.

omar-security: good. action items for follow-up: create postmortem RFC documenting why rolesync changed subject formatting, add an automated audit check that flags tenants referencing old principals, and coordinate customer comms. assigning owners in triage board.

sara-support: closing escalation with note: temporary compatibility grant created and will be removed after migration. putting the incident into support tracker and tagging account team.

audit-bot: incident-archive created id=INC-20260401-207, labels=[rbac, kms, customer-impact], severity=2

omar-security: extra — please add a short blameless note in the RFC about the decision path for roles-v2 and ensure we test KMS grant drift in staging next rollout.

jess-ps: will include test cases. marking this thread resolved. :lock_with_key:
